check: Page has meta title and meta description
steps: Open the website, inspect element, check the title and meta description tags.
expected: Meta title and description exist and relate to the page.

check: Homepage has 2-5 meta keywords
steps: Open the website, inspect element, check meta keywords.
expected: Home page has 2-5 keywords.

check: Home page title follows the home format
steps: Open the website and read the page title.
expected: Title relates to the page, using the home format (e.g. Company | tagline).

check: Other page titles relate to their page
steps: Open a non-home page and read the page title.
expected: Title relates to the page (e.g. Contact | Company).

check: H1 is present on every page
steps: View page source and look for an h1.
expected: Every page has an h1.

check: H1 text is unique across pages
steps: View page source and compare h1 text between pages.
expected: Each page has a different h1.

check: Each page has only one H1
steps: View page source and count h1 tags.
expected: Exactly one h1 per page.

check: H2 count is balanced and related to the content
steps: View page source and check h2 tags (HeadingsMap helps).
expected: Balanced h2 count; deeper structure uses h3/h4 where sensible.

check: Heading levels are in order
steps: Inspect headings.
expected: h1 then h2 then h3, with no skipped levels and no h1 after the first heading.

check: Breadcrumb is shown level by level and clickable
steps: Open a product or item listing page and check the breadcrumb.
expected: Breadcrumb shows each level and each level links to its page.

check: Product / item URLs follow the SEO policy
steps: Open a product or item detail page and read the URL.
expected: Readable, hyphenated slug (e.g. /villa-for-sale/villa-jepun).

check: Images have an alt attribute
steps: Inspect images and check the alt attribute.
expected: Every content image has an alt attribute.

check: Image alt text relates to the image
steps: Inspect images and read alt text.
expected: Alt text describes the image, product or item.

check: Favicon is the project icon
steps: Open the website and look at the favicon.
expected: Favicon is the project's logo or icon.

check: Home footer has the Powered by credit
steps: Check the footer on the home page.
expected: "Powered by PT Timedoor Indonesia", linked to timedoor.net with target blank, same color as the text.

check: Other pages have no Powered by credit
steps: Check the footer on a non-home page.
expected: Footer has no "Powered by PT Timedoor Indonesia" (avoids excess backlinks).

check: Open Graph tags on every page
steps: Inspect element and check OG meta tags.
expected: og:title, og:type, og:image and og:url exist.

check: Meta tags are not duplicated
steps: Inspect element and find all meta tags.
expected: Each OG, robots, description and keywords tag appears once per page.

check: Basic auth is visible on the dev website
steps: Open the website without credentials.
expected: A basic auth prompt is shown.

check: Google Analytics script is present
steps: Inspect element and search for gtag or analytics.
expected: Google Analytics script is available. Confirm with the PM that numbers arrive in the console.

check: Client company Google Map appears
steps: Open the contact page or any page with a map.
expected: The map appears and works.

check: robots.txt matches the phase
steps: Open website.com/robots.txt.
expected: Pre-launch: disallow all. Post-launch: crawling allowed.

check: Meta robots and googlebot match the phase
steps: Inspect element and check meta robots and googlebot.
expected: Pre-launch: noindex, nofollow. Post-launch: index, follow.

check: Website uses a captcha
steps: Search the page source for captcha / recaptcha.
expected: A recaptcha script is loaded.

check: Contact message is sent with the captcha
steps: Submit the contact form on the live site.
expected: The message is sent.

check: No broken links
steps: Run the site through a link checker.
expected: No broken links.

check: 404 page is shown for unknown URLs
steps: Open website.com/blablabla.
expected: A 404 page is shown.

check: http redirects to https
steps: Open http://website.com.
expected: Redirects to https://website.com.

check: http://www redirects to https non-www
steps: Open http://www.website.com.
expected: Redirects to https://website.com.

check: PageSpeed score meets the limits
steps: Run pagespeed.web.dev for the URL.
expected: Mobile at least 55 and desktop at least 85.

check: Image file sizes are within limits
steps: Inspect images and read their size.
expected: Up to 100 KB for most images, up to 200 KB for hero or large images.

check: Below-the-fold images use lazy loading
steps: Scroll the page and watch images load.
expected: Images below the fold load lazily.

check: Images are sharp and not stretched
steps: Look at images on the user website.
expected: High quality, not stretched; SVG for logos and icons. Ask the designer if unsure.

check: Admin crop is shown correctly on the website
steps: Upload and crop an image in admin, then check the user website.
expected: The image matches the crop set in admin.

check: Website colors follow the style guide
steps: Compare website colors with Figma (ColorZilla helps).
expected: Colors match the style guide.

check: Website fonts follow the style guide
steps: Compare website fonts with Figma (WhatFont helps).
expected: Fonts match the style guide.

check: Japanese websites use a JP font
steps: Compare fonts with Figma and confirm a JP font is used (e.g. Noto Sans JP).
expected: Japanese text uses a Japanese-specific font. Japanese sites only.

check: Letter spacing and line height match Figma
steps: Compare letter spacing and line height with Figma.
expected: Similar to Figma.

check: Button hover color matches the style guide
steps: Hover buttons and compare with Figma.
expected: Hover effect or color matches the style guide.

check: Button disabled color matches the style guide
steps: Find a disabled button and compare with Figma.
expected: Disabled color matches the style guide.

check: Margin and padding match Figma
steps: Compare margins and paddings with Figma.
expected: Similar to the design.

check: No lorem ipsum text
steps: Read the content on every page.
expected: No lorem ipsum or dummy text.

check: Content is real, not placeholder
steps: Read the content on every page.
expected: Content is the real client content.

check: Element contrast keeps content readable
steps: Check contrast between elements and content.
expected: Contrast does not hurt readability.

check: Hover effect on cards and elements matches the design
steps: Hover clickable cards and elements.
expected: Hover effect matches the design.

check: Active menu is highlighted on the open page
steps: Open a page and check the menu.
expected: The open page's menu item looks different from the others.

check: Active tab is highlighted
steps: Open a tab and check the tab menu.
expected: The open tab looks different from the others.

check: Tablet layout is correct
steps: Open the website at tablet size.
expected: Similar to desktop, or the tablet design if there is one.

check: Mobile layout is correct
steps: Open the website at mobile size.
expected: Matches the mobile design in Figma.

check: Error messages relate to the action
steps: Trigger an error (e.g. invalid email in the contact form).
expected: Message names the problem, e.g. "Please input the correct email address", not "invalid data".

check: Login error does not reveal which field is wrong
steps: Log in with wrong credentials.
expected: A message such as "Incorrect username or password".

check: Buttons, links and cards are easy to click
steps: Click elements across the site.
expected: Whole cards are clickable, not only the "see detail" button.

check: English dates use an accepted format
steps: Check date formats in English pages.
expected: MM/DD/YYYY or Month Date, Year.
